name: FlyingThings3D: Synthetic Dataset for Optical Flow and Disparity
description: FlyingThings3D is a synthetic benchmark dataset composed of everyday 3D objects moving along randomized 3D trajectories. Part of the Scene Flow dataset suite, it delivers 25,650 stereo frame pairs with dense, ground-truth optical flow, disparity, disparity change, and object segmentation masks.
